Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before retrying the same logical attempt.

parameters.description: Identifies one logical mutation attempt. Authentication and secret-bearing session mutations retain an encrypted replay for 15 minutes and protect key conflicts for 24 hours. A different operation, canonical request, or client context returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; an exact retry after the replay window returns IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_EXPIRED and must use a new key.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional caller trace value. Use only ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon, slash, or hyphen; credential-looking prefixes are rejected. Authorization denial audit uses a separate server-generated request id.

409.description: Revision or idempotency conflict. Authentication mutations may return IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_EXPIRED, or IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Identifies one logical mutation attempt. Authentication and secret-bearing session mutations retain an encrypted replay for 15 minutes and protect key conflicts for 24 hours. A different operation, canonical request, or client context returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; an exact retry after the replay window returns IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_EXPIRED and must use a new key.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional caller trace value. Use only ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon, slash, or hyphen; credential-looking prefixes are rejected. Authorization denial audit uses a separate server-generated request id.

403.description: CSRF or authorization failure

409.description: Conflict response for an execution-admission endpoint. When code is AGENT_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT, the target Agent has no free execution slot and details contain only safe capacity/state counts. The endpoint may also return another documented conflict code. Coordination Sessions are excluded from this count.

details.description: Safe diagnostics for AGENT_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT. Counts execution Sessions only and never exposes Session IDs or work content.

error.message: Agent execution concurrency limit reached. Coordination Sessions do not consume capacity; complete, stop, or cancel an execution Session, or increase maxConcurrency before retrying.

client_type.description: Supported client adapter kinds for Agent Connections.

status.description: Lifecycle state of an Agent Connection. pending = pairing code issued, not yet redeemed. active = at least one redeemed credential currently valid. rotating = two valid credentials during the 15-minute rotation overlap. revoked = all credentials revoked; the row is retained as immutable audit.

grant_agent_delegate.description: Cross-field invariant (also enforced in the Zod schema and on the server): if grant_agent_delegate is false, granted_capabilities MUST NOT contain agent:delegate. The previous dependentRequired was a no-op; the if/then/else above is the actual enforcement. False positives here return COORDINATOR_PRINCIPAL_HUMAN_INVALID or AGENT_CONNECTION_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.

skill_version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 of the Skill bundle the Agent is currently pinned to, or null if no redeem has happened yet. The official SemVer regex (https://semver.org) is used; the Zod regex in packages/contracts/src/index.ts is the same byte-for-byte. scripts/generate-stage5-subset-blocks.mjs keeps them in sync.

credential_fingerprint_prefix.description: First 12 characters of the active credential fingerprint; never the credential itself.

installation_token.description: Plaintext wmi_ Installation Token returned exactly once per pairing code. It is deliberately distinguishable from the wmp_ pairing code. The server stores only its fingerprint; clients must verify SHA-256(installation_token)[0:12] equals connection.credential_fingerprint_prefix before persisting it. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the exact same body (see idempotency_replay). Note: this is a response field, not an input field; the input-only flag is not set because strict client generators would strip the field and break first redeem and Idempotency-Key replay.

header.description: Custom header (not Authorization) to keep the token out of generic Bearer auth logs.

skill.description: Skill bundle returned by the redeem response. download_url is required here because the Agent must actually fetch the bundle. Note: this is a separate schema, not an allOf extension of AgentConnectionSkillManifest, so the additionalProperties:false on the base is not violated.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 per https://semver.org (leading zeros, consecutive dots, and missing build-metadata are forbidden). The Zod regex in packages/contracts/src/index.ts is the same byte-for-byte; scripts/generate-stage5-subset-blocks.mjs keeps them in sync.

signature.description: Detached signature of the Skill bundle

idempotency_replay.description: Server promise that replays with the same Idempotency-Key, before replayable_until, return the exact same response body. Implements the plan section 'Pairing and Connection Security' (public interface and security model): success responses are safely replayable via the existing encrypted authentication idempotency mechanism.

client_type.description: Supported client adapter kinds for Agent Connections.

status.description: Lifecycle state of an Agent Connection. pending = pairing code issued, not yet redeemed. active = at least one redeemed credential currently valid. rotating = two valid credentials during the 15-minute rotation overlap. revoked = all credentials revoked; the row is retained as immutable audit.

grant_agent_delegate.description: Cross-field invariant (also enforced in the Zod schema and on the server): if grant_agent_delegate is false, granted_capabilities MUST NOT contain agent:delegate. The previous dependentRequired was a no-op; the if/then/else above is the actual enforcement. False positives here return COORDINATOR_PRINCIPAL_HUMAN_INVALID or AGENT_CONNECTION_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.

skill_version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 of the Skill bundle the Agent is currently pinned to, or null if no redeem has happened yet. The official SemVer regex (https://semver.org) is used; the Zod regex in packages/contracts/src/index.ts is the same byte-for-byte. scripts/generate-stage5-subset-blocks.mjs keeps them in sync.

credential_fingerprint_prefix.description: First 12 characters of the active credential fingerprint; never the credential itself.

connect_url.description: New connect URL with the new wmp_ pairing code in the fragment. The old URL stays valid until overlap_until. Same fragment-only contract as AgentConnectionCreateResponse; no userinfo, no path/query credentials.

overlap_until.description: Real deadline after which the worker auto-invalidates the old fingerprint. The old Installation Token is accepted until this timestamp; afterwards only the new one is valid. There is no auto-revoke on the new redeem's success.

client_type.description: Supported client adapter kinds for Agent Connections.

status.description: Lifecycle state of an Agent Connection. pending = pairing code issued, not yet redeemed. active = at least one redeemed credential currently valid. rotating = two valid credentials during the 15-minute rotation overlap. revoked = all credentials revoked; the row is retained as immutable audit.

grant_agent_delegate.description: Cross-field invariant (also enforced in the Zod schema and on the server): if grant_agent_delegate is false, granted_capabilities MUST NOT contain agent:delegate. The previous dependentRequired was a no-op; the if/then/else above is the actual enforcement. False positives here return COORDINATOR_PRINCIPAL_HUMAN_INVALID or AGENT_CONNECTION_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.

skill_version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 of the Skill bundle the Agent is currently pinned to, or null if no redeem has happened yet. The official SemVer regex (https://semver.org) is used; the Zod regex in packages/contracts/src/index.ts is the same byte-for-byte. scripts/generate-stage5-subset-blocks.mjs keeps them in sync.

credential_fingerprint_prefix.description: First 12 characters of the active credential fingerprint; never the credential itself.

installation_token.description: Plaintext wmi_ Installation Token returned exactly once per pairing code. It is deliberately distinguishable from the wmp_ pairing code. The server stores only its fingerprint; clients must verify SHA-256(installation_token)[0:12] equals connection.credential_fingerprint_prefix before persisting it. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the exact same body (see idempotency_replay). Note: this is a response field, not an input field; the input-only flag is not set because strict client generators would strip the field and break first redeem and Idempotency-Key replay.

header.description: Custom header (not Authorization) to keep the token out of generic Bearer auth logs.

skill.description: Skill bundle returned by the redeem response. download_url is required here because the Agent must actually fetch the bundle. Note: this is a separate schema, not an allOf extension of AgentConnectionSkillManifest, so the additionalProperties:false on the base is not violated.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 per https://semver.org (leading zeros, consecutive dots, and missing build-metadata are forbidden). The Zod regex in packages/contracts/src/index.ts is the same byte-for-byte; scripts/generate-stage5-subset-blocks.mjs keeps them in sync.

signature.description: Detached signature of the Skill bundle

idempotency_replay.description: Server promise that replays with the same Idempotency-Key, before replayable_until, return the exact same response body. Implements the plan section 'Pairing and Connection Security' (public interface and security model): success responses are safely replayable via the existing encrypted authentication idempotency mechanism.

409.description: Revision or idempotency conflict. Authentication mutations may return IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_EXPIRED, or IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE.

429.description: Authentication admission or progressive credential backoff rejected the request without executing authentication or business side effects.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before retrying the same logical attempt.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Whole seconds until this request dimension may be admitted.

503.description: The shared Redis admission service is unavailable. Only credential-verification routes fail closed.
